name: sms-voice
description: Pinpoint SMS and Voice Messaging public facing APIs

subcommands.name: create-configuration-set-event-destination
subcommands.description: Create a new event destination in a configuration set.

subcommands.name: delete-configuration-set-event-destination
subcommands.description: Deletes an event destination in a configuration set.

subcommands.name: get-configuration-set-event-destinations
subcommands.description: Obtain information about an event destination, including the types of events it reports, the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the destination, and the name of the event destination.

subcommands.name: list-configuration-sets
subcommands.description: List all of the configuration sets associated with your Amazon Pinpoint account in the current region.

subcommands.name: send-voice-message
subcommands.description: Create a new voice message and send it to a recipient's phone number.

subcommands.name: update-configuration-set-event-destination
subcommands.description: Update an event destination in a configuration set.
